messages:
matt: Observability flagged a surge in attach validation latency in eu-north1 starting ~02:05 UTC. GPUs failing to attach, backlog growing.
olivia: Any commonalities across the failing hosts?
chen: Quick grep of the node logs shows repeated index renames during scrub/compact windows. Snippet from node en-n1-07:
```
2026-03-25T02:04:58Z janitor[pid=1210]: scrub: started range=[0x2c000-0x2cfff]
2026-03-25T02:05:00Z compactor[pid=1300]: rewrite-index id=0x2c7e tmp=index.2c7e.tmp
2026-03-25T02:05:01Z compactor[pid=1300]: rename index.2c7e.tmp -> index.2c7e
2026-03-25T02:05:01Z attach-controller[pid=4140]: validate-local-index node=en-n1-07 extent=0x2c7e err=FILE_NOT_FOUND
2026-03-25T02:05:02Z storage[pid=900]: attempted open index.2c7e -> ENOENT (rename raced with open)
```
tara: So the writer does a write->tmp->rename but attach tries to open in the small window where the file is being moved. Sounds like the filesystem semantics + our code race.
matt: How many nodes?
chen: Tally: 9 nodes in eu-north1, 3 in eu-west3 showing same pattern. All on scrub-runner v1.12.2 with fast-rename optimization enabled.
olivia: Immediate mitigations? We can't afford long routing changes for customers in EU.
tara: Short-term options: 1) introduce a tiny attach-side retry: if index open fails -> sleep(10ms) and retry once 2) throttle rename concurrency in compactor 3) temporarily prefer same-region warm-pool (avoid failing attaches)
matt: Can we flip a graceful backoff in attach-controller without deploy? Maybe config flag to enable retry path?
chen: There's a runtime feature-flag we can toggle via config-service. I'll add attach_retry_on_missing=true for the region group and roll config.
deploy-bot: Config update requested: set attach_retry_on_missing=true for env=prod region=eu-north1 -> applying
matt: Also, we should add a metric index_rename_rename_time and a small histogram to see rename latency distribution. If rename takes >50ms we need a different approach.
olivia: What about making renames atomic at a directory level using openat techniques? That's a code change, longer-term.
tara: Agree. For now make attach-side retry + throttle rename parallelism. Chen, can you prepare a small compactor config change to reduce concurrent_renames from 5 -> 1 in the group?
chen: On it. Rolling to 3 nodes as canary now.
deploy-bot: Config rollout to canary nodes completed. Monitoring attach success.
matt: Any user-visible impact so far?
chen: GPU attach pending for jobs in the region peaked at 3.1k, after applying config & retry we saw it drop to 650 within 8 minutes. Latency tail reduced for attach validation from 420ms -> 95ms p95.
olivia: Nice. Cost impact: some customers will see slightly higher scheduling latency; if we route to other regions that'd add egress (~€0.10/hr). We're avoiding that for now.
tara: Follow-ups: a) implement attach re-verify after open (if rename seen) b) compactor should use atomic replace via link+rename where possible and hold a short advisory lock during rename c) add alert when attach_retries_per_min > 20 for a region
matt: Capture AS-IS: file-level races between rename and open caused ENOENT; attach had no retry. Root cause: aggressive rename optimization in v1.12.2 + higher disk controller IO jitter.
chen: I'll open PR ops/attach-retry-rename-2026 and ops/compactor-rename-lock-2026. Will run unit tests that simulate rename window.
deploy-bot: PR ops/attach-retry-rename-2026 created and CI passed. Image built sha256:abcd... Ready for canary.
matt: Plan: enable config retry in eu-north1 (done), deploy attach-retry patch to canary nodes (5), run compactor throttle rollout (k-roll) once canary stable, then full rollout.
olivia: Who's owning the postmortem? matt & chen. Please include mitigation timeline and cost estimate for routing fallback.
tara: Also schedule a maintenance job to scan for any orphaned tmp-index files older than 1h and reconcile.
matt: Thanks. Good catch, team. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Incident logged INC-20260325-rename-open-race. Postmortem owners: matt/chen.
